id: title:Gilbert09:propagate a dropped connection during the duplicate key check

review.posthog_relevance: Redshift warehouse ingestion reliability and duplicate-key detection
review.reason: Adds an exception handler for psycopg.OperationalError in Redshift duplicate-key checks, preserving the retry path for transient connection failures instead of falsely reporting no duplicates. Includes a corresponding unit test asserting the exception propagates and is not reported to error tracking.
review.uncertainty: The benefit relies on the assumption that the connection failure is transient and retry is desired; while the code implements this, the actual production benefit depends on the frequency and nature of such failures, which is not established by the diff.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a new exception handler for psycopg.OperationalError in the Redshift duplicate-key probe, re-raising the exception instead of returning False.
